name: Himegami Elmes
source: A top idol popular all over Japan, she is the beauty known as the school’s top princess—the “Princess Empress.” She is the manifestation of beauty. If she winks towards you up close, you might be blown away by how cute she really is. While she rarely attends school due to her busy lifestyle, she for some reason sometimes appears in front of Minato to have friendly conversation. There are many mysteries in her actions such as these.
